介面重塑素材：一張一張貼

每一張照順序做：① 按「複製參考圖」，到 Gemini 貼上（Ctrl+V）；② 按「複製 Prompt」，貼在同一則訊息；送出。③ 生好的圖傳給 AI，說「這是第幾張」。一次傳一張，等 AI 回了再傳下一張。
勾「生好了」會記在這台電腦上，下次打開還在。

Left 58% of the screen: a full-bleed dim cellar scene as the stage, with a tall stack of cardboard boxes with two glowing yellow eyes as the monster standing large in the middle, a wine-red ribbon banner with three claw scratch marks under it and a long glowing lava-red pressure bar with brass end caps below the banner, and along the bottom edge a row of four round empty parchment seats on woven rugs, each with a small brass status plate under it, the second seat glowing red as selected. Everything fits on one screen with no scrolling and no text, large touch targets. flat front view, no perspective, soft light from the upper left, hand-painted 2D game UI, muted warm palette with dark carved wood, aged brass, wine red and parchment, cozy old museum mood, clean readable layout, no frog, no animal, no face of any living creature
